title: Rutile settings
description: Every setting of the shell (D45). The shell reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rutile/settings.json and managed.json against this schema; the home-manager module builds its options from it.

speed.title: Animation speed
speed.description: How fast every animation runs: 1 is Material's speed, 2 twice as fast, 0 turns motion off.

pins.title: Pinned apps
pins.description: Desktop entry ids pinned to the shelf, in order. Unset: the first installed file manager, browser and terminal.

sound.title: Notification sound
sound.description: Play a sound when a notification pops up (with pw-play): the sender's sound, or the sound theme's message sound. Never in Do not disturb, except for critical ones.
